findingDetails.title: The CLI catalog still describes two guard failure classes and no sync authored-root precondition
findingDetails.case: An operator reads the bin catalog to learn what the compiled-routing gates report; after this change the guard has a third failure class (authored-missing, guard.cjs:76) and sync build/--check stop before lstat when the authored program directory is missing (sync.cjs:1061,1110), but the catalog entries at :25 and :164 still list only freshness mismatch and runtime/authored disagreement, and the sync row at :165 names no precondition.
findingDetails.evidence: bin/README.md:25 and :164 restate only the two older failure classes; bin/README.md:165 describes the sync publication flow without the restore failure; guard.cjs:76 and :181 add the authored-missing class and its printed line.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: rg -ln over .skilled/skills and .skilled/commands found no other catalog or skill doc restating the guard contract; the README rows are not generated and no test reads them.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The six-file scope excludes docs and CHK-042 is P2-optional, so the update may belong to a later phase; no committed artifact records that deferral.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: An update to bin/README.md:25/:164/:165, or a recorded deferral naming the owner.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The behavior-change identifiers appear in only two non-spec docs: this README and the in-scope YAML; the README is the only file enumerating the guard failure classes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the missing-authored-source class and the sync restore precondition to the catalog rows, or record the deferral.

findingDetails.title: T2/T4 pin the helper record, not the guard failure line that REQ-002/REQ-004 and the ledger name
findingDetails.case: REQ-002 and REQ-004 require the guard's printed line to name the paths; T2/T4 call guard.authoredDrift directly and assert the returned record (test:587, test:605), while the line is produced only in main's render loop (guard.cjs:174,181). Deleting either render line (guard.cjs:177,182) leaves all tests green and the printed promise broken.
findingDetails.evidence: The manifest suite requires the guard only for the helper (test:28); the only guard CLI spawn in any suite is the unknown-option rejection in typo-flags.test.cjs:106.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: rg over the repository for compiled-route-guard.cjs lists git hooks, the routing-registry-drift workflow and a benchmark script as consumers (exit-code readers only) plus the two test files above; no suite asserts the guard's failure rendering.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: D5 asks for one test per behavior change and the substantive change is the fix-string derivation; the render loop is thin formatting and a sandboxed guard spawn needs the freshness inputs, so helper-level coverage may be a deliberate trade.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A test that renders the guard failures (sandboxed spawn or extracted render function), or a decision record that helper-level evidence satisfies T2/T4.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The two test files above are the only test surfaces referencing the guard; within them only the helper and the unknown-option path are exercised. Distinct from R1-P2-001, which covers the sync build-path entry guard.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extract the failure rendering into a tested function, or add a sandboxed guard spawn following T3's copy pattern asserting the copy/restore lines.
